verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Cryptic Gaze (Q) and get chained into a Death's Caress (W) pop; you win if you force Sion into long auto-trades where his own Enrage (E) burns more HP than yours.

brief.thesis: Kled holds a 53.7% head-to-head over 54 games with both lane and solo-kill advantage, and the reason is mechanical: Sion's E (Enrage) has no cooldown but pays for its bonus AD in his own permanent health, so every extra auto he throws in a trade costs him more than it costs you. The one swing piece is his Q (Cryptic Gaze), a 550-range single-target stun on a 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown — bait it or eat it on Skaarl before you commit, because it chains straight into his point-blank W (Death's Caress) shield.

theirWindow.when: Sion's Q (Cryptic Gaze) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: Cryptic Gaze is a 550-range single-target stun — don't dash in raw with E (Jousting) while it's up. Let it land on Skaarl's health bar or walk him into using it before you commit, since a stun into his autos plus a Death's Caress (W) pop can swing the trade hard.

yourWindow.when: right after Sion's W (Death's Caress) shield pops
yourWindow.what: Death's Caress is only 100 range and sits on an 8s cooldown, so once it's detonated he has no absorb. Chain E (Jousting) in, land Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) for the extra damage and yank, and hold the trade — his Enrage (E) is spending his own HP faster than you're spending yours.

start.why: The run pick at 52.6% win rate and 86.4% pick rate — the extra sustain matters when you're trading autos through Sion's Enrage rather than poking and backing off.

boots.why: Most-picked boots in the matchup at 69.8% pick rate; flat armor blunts the repeated physical autos Sion throws while Enrage is toggled and the damage from his W (Death's Caress) explosion.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the exact extended auto-trades that punish Sion's Enrage the hardest, and converts to healing once fully stacked for the sustain war.

summoners.why: The most-run pair at 66.1% pick rate. Ignite's damage-over-time cuts through the healing from Sion's R (Cannibalism) and converts your measured solo-kill advantage into actual kills before he scales out of range.

playing.title: Bait Cryptic Gaze before you joust
playing.detail: Sion's Q is a 550-range single-target stun on a 12-8s cooldown. Walk Skaarl into range or wait for him to throw it before you commit E (Jousting), or you'll get chained into a trade you didn't choose.

playing.title: Hold trades, don't poke
playing.detail: Sion's E (Enrage) has no cooldown but spends his own health for AD on every auto. The longer the trade runs, the worse it is for him — stay in it instead of disengaging early.

playing.title: Punish the shield pop
playing.detail: Death's Caress (W) is only 100 range and sits on an 8s cooldown. Once it detonates, he has no absorb — that's your window to commit Jousting (E) and Bear Trap (Q).

playing.title: Time Violent Tendencies into the dash
playing.detail: Pop W (Violent Tendencies) for the four empowered attacks and land them inside an E (Jousting) dash-back so the burst lands before his Cryptic Gaze comes off cooldown again.

playing.title: Respect Cannibalism windows
playing.detail: From level 6, Sion's R leeches health to himself and nearby allies and boosts his attack speed. Don't start a long trade the instant he pops it — it's on a 90s cooldown, so wait it out if you can.

playing.title: Spike your all-ins at 10-14
playing.detail: Titanic Hydra and Black Cleaver come online in this window; the armor shred offsets the max HP Sion's been stacking from Enrage kills, so this is when your dives are most profitable.

playing.title: Save R for a clean pick
playing.detail: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! has a 140-110s cooldown and 3500 range — use it to collapse on Sion when he's isolated and Cryptic Gaze is down, not as a reaction to his engage.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build order, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the trade timing, stun-baiting, and cooldown reasoning are my own read of the kit, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Although you can easily gain control over lane by applying pressure, Sion’s Decimating Smash (Q) and Unstoppable Onslaught (R) can pose a threat as they can easily be used to kill you. Use Jousting [E] carefully.
